A day for each feast

Hanukkah (Festival of Lights)

Hanukkah First Night Celebration

Celebrate the first night of Hanukkah by honoring the miracle of the oil with light, food, and family traditions.

  1. Late Afternoon

    Prepare Festive Foods

    Begin by cooking traditional Hanukkah dishes fried in oil to commemorate the miracle. Prepare potato latkes and sufganiyot to enjoy later in the evening.

    Recipes: Potato Latkes · Sufganiyot

  2. Evening

    Kindle the Menorah and Recite Blessings

    Light the first candle on the menorah together as a family and recite the blessings to mark the start of the eight-day festival.

  3. After Lighting

    Play Dreidel Games

    Engage in the traditional dreidel game, sharing gelt as prizes to celebrate joy and resilience.

  4. Dinner Time

    Enjoy a Festive Dinner

    Serve a warm meal featuring braised brisket and kugel alongside the freshly made latkes, bringing the family together to share in the holiday spirit.

    Recipes: Braised Brisket · Traditional Noodle Kugel · Potato Latkes

  5. Dessert

    Savor Sufganiyot and Bimuelos

    End the meal with sweet treats fried in oil, including sufganiyot and bimuelos, honoring the festival's culinary traditions.

    Recipes: Sufganiyot · Bimuelos

  6. Evening Reflection

    Acts of Charity and Gratitude

    Take time to reflect on the themes of resilience and giving by planning or performing acts of charity as a family.

Close the night with gratitude, looking forward to the remaining nights of light and celebration.
